titlePl: Matura PP: Zdrowie — 36 haseł do gier LingoSpark
titleEn: Matura Basic: Health — 36 terms for LingoSpark games
blurbPl: Słownictwo z działu Zdrowie na maturę podstawową: objawy, wizyta u lekarza, leczenie. Listy do wklejenia w gry LingoSpark + karty pracy.
blurbEn: Matura basic-level Health vocabulary: symptoms, GP visits, treatment. Paste-ready LingoSpark lists plus worksheets.

items.definitionEn: signs that show you may be ill
items.example: Describe your symptoms clearly when you call the clinic.

items.definitionEn: to force air from your throat, often when you have a cold
items.example: A dry cough kept her awake all night.

items.definitionEn: pain in the throat, often with a cold
items.example: I have a sore throat and I cannot swallow easily.

items.definitionEn: when liquid comes from your nose because of a cold
items.example: A runny nose is annoying but usually not serious.

items.definitionEn: when your body is hotter than normal because you are ill
items.example: If you have a high temperature, stay at home.

items.definitionEn: a serious illness with fever, aches and tiredness
items.example: He caught the flu in January and missed a week of school.

items.definitionEn: to injure a joint by twisting it
items.example: She sprained her ankle during the match.

items.definitionEn: a dark mark on the skin after a hit
items.example: There is a large bruise on his knee after the fall.

items.definitionEn: an injury where the skin is cut or broken
items.example: Clean the wound and put on a plaster.

items.definitionEn: a written order from a doctor for medicine
items.example: Take this prescription to the chemist.

items.definitionEn: a shop that sells medicine; the person who prepares it
items.example: The chemist is next to the supermarket.

items.definitionEn: a general doctor you visit first, not a hospital specialist
items.example: Make an appointment with your GP if the pain continues.

items.definitionEn: an arranged time to see a doctor or other professional
items.example: I have a dentist appointment at three o'clock.

items.definitionEn: medical care given to a patient
items.example: The treatment for this infection lasts ten days.

items.definitionEn: to get better after an illness or injury
items.example: It took her a month to recover after the operation.

items.definitionEn: to become well again after an illness
items.example: It took him two weeks to get over the stomach bug.

items.definitionEn: becoming ill when you eat, touch or breathe something
items.example: He is allergic to peanuts, so check every label.

items.definitionEn: an injection that protects you from a disease
items.example: The vaccination against measles is given in childhood.

items.definitionEn: a regular visit to a doctor when you are not ill
items.example: You should have a dental check-up twice a year.

items.definitionEn: time away from work or school because you are ill
items.example: The doctor gave her three days of sick leave.

items.definitionEn: illness caused by eating bad food
items.example: He had food poisoning after the buffet.

items.definitionEn: a continuous pain
items.example: I have a dull ache in my lower back.

items.definitionEn: feeling that you might fall, as if the room is spinning
items.example: She felt dizzy after standing up too quickly.

items.definitionEn: to become unconscious for a short time
items.example: He almost fainted in the crowded, hot hall.

items.definitionEn: larger than normal because of injury or illness
items.example: Her wrist is swollen, so she cannot write.

items.definitionEn: a strip of cloth used to cover an injury
items.example: The nurse put a bandage around his hand.

items.definitionEn: medicine that reduces pain
items.example: Do not take more than two painkillers at a time.

items.definitionEn: a medical operation
items.example: He will need surgery on his knee in March.

items.definitionEn: a room in a hospital with beds for patients
items.example: She is in the children's ward on the second floor.

items.definitionEn: a vehicle that takes sick or injured people to hospital
items.example: Someone called an ambulance after the accident.

items.definitionEn: to stay healthy through exercise
items.example: She goes swimming twice a week to keep fit.

items.definitionEn: to become ill with a common cold
items.example: You can catch a cold if you sit in wet clothes.

items.definitionEn: to feel slightly ill
items.example: I feel under the weather, so I will stay in tonight.

items.definitionEn: lasting a long time, of an illness
items.example: He has chronic back pain and cannot sit for long.

items.definitionEn: the condition of your mind and emotions
items.example: Schools now talk more openly about mental health.

items.definitionEn: simple medical help given before a doctor arrives
items.example: Every teacher should know basic first aid.
